_doc: ReShade add-ons offered in ReShade > Addons besides ReShade's own list (crosire/reshade-shaders, Addons.ini). 'source' is a GitHub repository's latest release (its .addon32/.addon64 files, or a ZIP holding them), direct links to the two files, or a ZIP. After RHI's extras (github.com/RankFTW/RHI); its DLSS5 tools are left out, as they need DLLs placed per game.

addons.name: ReShade HDR Metadata
addons.description: Writes HDR metadata (MaxCLL, MaxFALL, MinCLL) to the swap chain, so Windows and TVs read ReShade's HDR signal right. Helps displays that tone map by metadata; DirectX 11 and 12.

addons.name: RenoDX Upgrade
addons.description: Inverse tone mapping and render target upgrades for HDR in DirectX 9 and newer games. Pair it with the RenoFX HDR Toolkit shaders; RenoDX and Luma mods do not need it.

addons.name: RenoDX DevKit
addons.description: RenoDX's tools for finding and debugging a game's shaders, for mod authors.

addons.name: RenoDX DLSS Fix
addons.description: Makes ReShade draw on the game's own frames, not on DLSS's generated ones, and hides DLSS upscaling from ReShade. 64-bit only.

addons.name: Depth3D Cursor Add-on
addons.description: Draws a cursor at the right depth in Depth3D stereo 3D games. Needs the Depth3D shader pack.

addons.name: ReShade Screenshot Discord Fix
addons.description: Removes the cICP colour chunk from ReShade's PNG screenshots, so Discord shows HDR screenshots right from their ICC profile. Nothing to set up.

addons.name: ReshadeEffectShaderToggler (REST) by BadassBaboon
addons.description: A newer fork of REST: applies ReShade's effects at a chosen point of the frame (under the HUD, say) by groups of the game's shaders, with scene colour for DLSS and dynamic resolution, Vulkan shader hunting and HUD hiding. Needs ReShade 6.8; use this or 4lex4nder's REST, not both.
